content.text:
**Finding: compliant — no redline proposed.**

The renewal package in §§ 8.2–8.3 already meets our preferred position in full:

| Preferred element | Document position |
|---|---|
| Automatic renewal only on permitted terms | § 8.2 auto-renews Order Forms, satisfying every conditional element below |
| Renewal term ≤ 12 months | "successive twelve-month periods" |
| Customer opt-out ≤ 30 days' notice | "at least thirty days' written notice of non-renewal" (30-day window) |
| Vendor reminder ≥ 60 days before renewal | "at least sixty days beforehand", plus opt-out deadline extends 30 days if the reminder is missed |
| Uplift ≤ lesser of CPI and 3% | § 8.3 "the lesser of the increase in the United States Consumer Price Index … and three percent", 90 days' notice, no increase on prepaid periods |

No walk-away trigger exists: the notice window is 30 days (not >90), and there is no automatic multi-year renewal — § 8.1's three-year period is a fixed initial term with no renewal mechanic. I checked all "renew"/"increase"/"term" hits document-wide; nothing outside § 8 lengthens the window, extends the renewal term, or permits an uncapped uplift. The § 2.1 three-year take-or-pay commitment does bear on practical exit, but it is a minimum-commitment issue for that rule and is not double-flagged here.
